title: Result of send() ignored (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract calls send() as a bare statement. send() returns false on failure instead of reverting, so ignoring its result lets the contract continue as if the transfer completed. This lexical rule flags a send whose result is not consumed; the reviewer confirms the failure path is handled.
remediation: Use a require on the returned bool, or a pull-payment pattern.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: a bare send call matches. Calls on a parenthesised receiver, such as payable(x).send, are not matched. A user-defined send method (for example an ERC-777 token send) can match and is not a boolean call.
